comments.author: D Gallagher
comments.body: I don't know. It seems like the "enhanced" back button would weigh heavy on the processor, kind of the way that fruit menu slows to a near-halt when you have icons turned on at all levels and previews enabled. Also, it reminds me of those sidebar/thumnail preview in place of tabs discussions on the Chimera list. I like the Mozilla implementation, where there is a separate small arrow icon so there's no getting the drop down menu when you just wanna go back.
